claims.text: For incident patients in Denmark, the mean CHA2DS2-VASc score was 1.73 with a standard deviation of 1.07, median 2.00, minimum 0.00, and maximum 6.00 across 19,671 patients [^src1]
Region Hovedstaden had 5,241 incident patients with a mean CHA2DS2-VASc score of 1.66 [^src1]
Sjælland had 3,202 incident patients with a mean CHA2DS2-VASc score of 1.82 [^src1]
Syddanmark had 4,580 incident patients with a mean CHA2DS2-VASc score of 1.75 [^src1]
Midtjylland had 4,446 incident patients with a mean CHA2DS2-VASc score of 1.71 [^src1]
Nordjylland had 2,202 incident patients with a mean CHA2DS2-VASc score of 1.75 [^src1]
Among incident female patients in Denmark, 39.79% had a CHA2DS2-VASc score <2 and 60.21% had a score ≥2 (n=8,209) [^src1]
Among incident male patients in Denmark, 45.18% had a CHA2DS2-VASc score <2 and 54.82% had a score ≥2 (n=11,462) [^src1]
For prevalent patients in Denmark, the mean age at diagnosis was 70 years with a standard deviation of 12, median 72, minimum 0, and maximum 104 across 134,810 patients [^src1]
Region Hovedstaden had 37,707 prevalent patients with a mean age at diagnosis of 69 years [^src1]
Sjælland had 21,755 prevalent patients with a mean age at diagnosis of 70 years [^src1]
Syddanmark had 31,541 prevalent patients with a mean age at diagnosis of 71 years [^src1]
Midtjylland had 29,390 prevalent patients with a mean age at diagnosis of 70 years [^src1]
Nordjylland had 14,417 prevalent patients with a mean age at diagnosis of 70 years [^src1]
For prevalent patients in Denmark, the mean CHA2DS2-VASc score was 1.47 with a standard deviation of 1.08, median 1.00, minimum 0.00, and maximum 6.00 across 134,810 patients [^src1]
Region Hovedstaden had 37,707 prevalent patients with a mean CHA2DS2-VASc score of 1.42 [^src1]
Sjælland had 21,755 prevalent patients with a mean CHA2DS2-VASc score of 1.54 [^src1]
Syddanmark had 31,541 prevalent patients with a mean CHA2DS2-VASc score of 1.52 [^src1]
Midtjylland had 29,390 prevalent patients with a mean CHA2DS2-VASc score of 1.44 [^src1]
Nordjylland had 14,417 prevalent patients with a mean CHA2DS2-VASc score of 1.48 [^src1]
Among prevalent female patients in Denmark, 14.19% had a CHA2DS2-VASc score of 0, 37.57% had a score of 1, and 31.01% had a score of 2 (n=56,112) [^src1]
Among prevalent male patients in Denmark, 22.37% had a CHA2DS2-VASc score of 0, 35.57% had a score of 1, and 25.74% had a score of 2 (n=78,698) [^src1]
CHA2DS2-VASc score calculation did not award points for female sex, and a threshold of ≥2 was applied as the cutoff for anticoagulation treatment indication in both sexes [^src1]

context: Dette afsnit præsenterer detaljerede statistikker fra Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark for perioden 1. juli 2022 til 30. juni 2023. Dataene omfatter både incidente (nydiagnosticerede) og prævalente (eksisterende) patienter med atrieflimren fordelt på fem danske regioner: Region Hovedstaden, Sjælland, Syddanmark, Midtjylland og Nordjylland. Afsnittene dokumenterer aldersfordelingen ved diagnose og CHA2DS2-VASc-scoringer, som er en vigtig klinisk risikostratificeringsværktøj for vurdering af slagrisiko og indikation for antikoagulationsbehandling hos patienter med atrieflimren.
